note: Vehicles without a parts catalogue in the app, as given by the owner. Each is added once at start-up as a machine (keyed by VIN: never duplicated or changed). Parts are added later with Settings -> Import from Excel (Equipment column) or from a parts catalogue. VIN check digits are verified at import.

vehicles.source: Given by the owner in chat (model, year and VIN), 2026-10-26. VIN: LGW = Great Wall Motor (WMI), 10th character G = model year 2016, check digit X verified.
